title: Ling Yuan's Secret Scheme Revealed
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's figure vanished into the depths of the secret realm, leaving only those whispered words echoing in the air—"Chen Ji... The fate between us runs deeper than you can imagine." Chen Ji's fists clenched, his knuckles whitening. At this moment, he finally realized that the bloodline mystery between himself and the former Tianqing Sect Master was far more complex than he had imagined...

text.content: The lingering resonance of the seven-day agreement had not yet faded. In the depths of the secret realm, a faint medicinal fragrance mingled with the scent of blood. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze shifting from Ye Qing's deep, profound eyes to the distant dark cliff face. The demonic path saintess's intuition was always sharp. If she had spoken such words as "it's not just a transaction," she must have already sensed some clues he had yet to reveal. However, at this moment, another shadow was approaching his heart. Mo Xiansheng's residual soul within the Tianji Record trembled slightly—a long-unfelt warning. The scent of danger, like an intangible cold wind in winter.

dialogue.content: "What are you thinking?" Ye Qing's voice broke Chen Ji's reverie. She walked closer, demonic path mist swirling subtly around her. "From just now, your aura has become... unstable." Her gaze carried a scrutinizing quality, honed through countless life-and-death struggles.

text.content: As Chen Ji was about to speak, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. It was a resonance he had never felt before—not the killing intent of an external enemy, but a call from deep within his bloodline. Like an invisible thread, it connected him to some existence in the depths of the secret realm. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying rare gravity: "He's here. Be careful. This person's cultivation... far exceeds your imagination."

dialogue.content: "Hehe... A servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect, daring to venture here alone." An elderly yet imposing voice emerged from the darkness, accompanied by heavy footsteps. Ling Yuan's figure slowly stepped out from the shadows. His wide Taoist robe fluttered despite the absence of wind. He appeared only in his sixties, but the pressure contained within those deep eyes caused the very air to freeze. "I thought you would hide behind those ants forever, never daring to show yourself."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained unmoved. He slightly bowed, assuming a respectful posture, his voice steady without a trace offluctuation: "Disciple greets Master Ancestor. May I ask if Master Ancestor has urgent business in the secret realm?" Hearing this, Ling Yuan's lips curved into an amused smile—containing mockery and some inexplicable, complex emotion.

dialogue.content: "Acting." Ling Yuan approached slowly, each step seeming to tread on Chen Ji's heartstrings. "Did you think this old man doesn't know about those pieces you've positioned in the Tianqing Sect over the years?" His gaze swept over Chen Ji like physical substance. "Servant disciple? Waste persona?" He coldly smiled. "Chen Xuan was also such a skilled actor in his time."

text.content: Chen Xuan. This name struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. His pupils slightly contracted, his fists secretly clenching within his sleeves. This name was precisely what he had found in a fragmentary scroll in the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters—the previous inheritor of the Tianji Record, a genius who mysteriously vanished thirty years ago. And between this Sect Master before him and that name, there seemed to be some connection he had yet to fathom. Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a faint glow. Chen Ji's "Heavenly Eye" opened involuntarily—he saw on Ling Yuan's chest, a bloodline mark identical to his own.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan seemed to sense something. A flash of surprise crossed his eyes, then transformed into deeper amusement. He stopped, only three zhang away from Chen Ji, and softly said: "It seems you've already seen it." His voice suddenly became gentler, yet more chilling. "Then, this old man will let you see clearly—what relationship truly exists between us." He slowly raised his hand, undoing his Taoist robe's collar, revealing an ancient,血色 blood-colored mark.

text.content: The mark resembled a coiling dragon, its entire body crimson as blood, winding an astonishing trajectory across Ling Yuan's aged chest. The mark Chen Ji had seen in his "Heavenly Eye" moments ago was almost identical—except his own mark lay hidden deep within his dantian, never revealed to anyone. At this moment, countless thoughts flashed through Chen Ji's mind like lightning. Bloodline mark, inheritor candidate, the Tianji Record's "selection"... All clues pointed to a possibility that made his spine chill.

dialogue.content: "Are you wondering," Ling Yuan re-tied his garment, his smile growing increasingly sinister, "why the Tianji Record chose a waste like you instead of me?" His voice was like ice. "Thirty years ago, I was the candidate selected by the Tianji Record. It was him—" His gaze suddenly turned sharp. "It was that traitor Chen Xuan, who used despicable means to steal everything that should have been mine!"

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's venomous words slithered like a poisonous snake. Chen Ji had to respond. Mo Xiansheng's whisper rang in his ear: "The Tianji Record has never chosen the wrong person. Ling Yuan's words... are not necessarily trustworthy." Yet the resonance of the bloodline mark was tangible. At this moment, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Directly question Ling Yuan about the bloodline mark and Chen Xuan's truth—risky but potentially可以获得 key information.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal one's own awareness and preparations
choices.visible_reward: May obtain core intelligence about bloodline and inheritance
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's cultivation far exceeds imagination; direct confrontation carries extremely high risk

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, directly gazing into Ling Yuan's profound eyes: "Master Ancestor says the Tianji Record chose the wrong person?" His voice was eerily calm. "Then may I ask, where does this bloodline mark originate? What is the relationship between disciple and Chen Xuan?" As his words fell, the air in the secret realm seemed to solidify. Ling Yuan's eyes slightly narrowed, as if reassessing this "waste" before him.

choices.description: Avoid direct conflict with Ling Yuan; first preserve strength and leave the secret realm to plan for the long term.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon this opportunity to understand the truth
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself, leaving room for future scheming
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best timing to understand the bloodline truth

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyelids, concealing all emotional fluctuations beneath a mask of calm. He bowed respectfully: "Disciple is foolish, not understanding Master Ancestor's words. Since it is a misunderstanding, disciple will not disturb Master Ancestor's cultivation. Disciple takes his leave." Ling Yuan's gaze lingered on him for a moment, then burst into a meaningful laugh.

choices.description: Do not reveal true intentions; retreat to advance, probing how much Ling Yuan knows.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise control of words; any slight carelessness may expose weaknesses
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information without alerting Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is deeply scheming; probing may be counteracted

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, a perfectly timed expression of confusion and fear flickering in his eyes: "Master Ancestor... disciple truly does not understand what you're saying. Tianji Record? Chen Xuan? Disciple is merely a servant disciple. How could I possibly接触到 these things..." His voice trembled slightly—a flawless performance. Ling Yuan stared at him for a long while, then suddenly laughed.

Ling Yuan's laughter echoed through the empty secret realm, carrying mockery, and perhaps... appreciation? "Interesting." He stood with hands behind his back, his wide sleeves gently drifting despite the windless air. "Compared to Chen Xuan back then, you child are better at concealing your talents." His gaze deepened. "But do you think with your shallow abilities, you can hide anything from this old man?" Before his words finished, an invisible pressure suddenly descended. Chen Ji felt his chest tighten, nearly causing him to kneel.

dialogue.content: The pressure came quickly and left quickly. Ling Yuan withdrew his aura, his expression turning playful: "Relax. This old man isn't here to kill you today." He turned his back to Chen Ji, his voice ethereal as wind: "Some things are more interesting than killing you. For instance—" He paused. "Letting you watch with your own eyes as the people you care about disappear, one by one." His tone was nonchalant, yet Chen Ji's blood nearly froze.

text.content: Chen Ji bit down hard on his molars, his fingernails deeply embedding into his palms. For a moment, killing intent surged in his chest like magma, but he forcibly suppressed it at the last moment. Remember the grudge, don't be reckless. He silently recited. Remembered. Every word, every expression of Ling Yuan's, he carved into his heart. Someday, he would collect the principal plus interest. However, at this moment, he had to endure. Mo Xiansheng's warning echoed in his ear: Ling Yuan's cultivation was at least at the Nascent Soul pinnacle—absolutely beyond his current capability to contend with.

dialogue.content: "However," Ling Yuan suddenly stopped, turning his head to reveal half of his aged, sinister face, "on account of that mark, this old man will spare you today." His voice was low and eerie. "Keep that life well, Chen Ji. Perhaps one day, you'll need it to unravel a shocking secret—" His gaze was meaningful. "About your bloodline, about Chen Xuan, about... your own identity."

text.content: The words fell. Ling Yuan's figure dissolved like a ghost into the darkness, as if he had never appeared. Yet the lingering aura of that invisible pressure still permeated the secret realm, Chen Ji's back already soaked with cold sweat. He slowly unclenched his tightly gripped fists, gazing at the deep crescent-shaped marks on his palm, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes. Ling Yuan's words, like venomous snakes, burrowed into his heart, taking root and sprouting there. What was the relationship between him and Chen Xuan? Where did the bloodline mark originate? And what was that "shocking secret"?

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows. Uncharacteristically, her face carried a hint of solemnity: "The old man left?" She walked to Chen Ji's side, lowering her voice. "I was hiding nearby just now and heard some things... If that bloodline mark is real, the relationship between you and him is probably not simply that of Master Ancestor and disciple." Her gaze was complex. "This game of chess runs far deeper than I imagined."

choice.prompt: After Ling Yuan left, Chen Ji faced new choices. Ye Qing's words made him realize that uncovering the bloodline mystery could change the entire situation's trajectory. How should he act?

choices.description: Immediately begin investigating the origin of the bloodline mark, seeking clues from Tianqing Sect ancient records and Chen Xuan's remains.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes significant time and energy; may alert the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Gradually uncover the bloodline truth and seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may already be on guard; investigation process is fraught with danger

text.content: Chen Ji slightly nodded, the confusion in his eyes gradually replaced by determination: "I need to know the truth." His voice was low. "What truly happened thirty years ago, the grudge between Chen Xuan and Ling Yuan, and... where the mark on my body originates." Ye Qing looked at him, then softly said: "I'll help you. The Holy Sect's intelligence network may be able to find some things."

choices.description: Keep the bloodline mark matter temporarily secret; first consolidate one's own strength, waiting for the right moment to investigate.
choices.visible_cost: Truth remains unresolved; psychological burden increases
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the secret; can be used as a trump card at a critical moment
choices.risk_hint: Time delay may lead to more variables

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing down all surging emotions: "This matter... do not mention it to anyone for now." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Including Su Qingyao." Ye Qing slightly Startled, then nodded: "As long as you have a plan in mind." A hint of understanding flickered in her gaze—this was Chen Ji,越是危急关头,越是calm得可怕.

choices.description: Su Qingyao is the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow; perhaps she knows some secrets of the Tianqing Sect. First probe her attitude, then decide whether to disclose.
choices.visible_cost: May expose the secret to a third party
choices.visible_reward: Gain support and intelligence from a reliable ally
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's relationship with Ling Yuan is unclear; rash disclosure carries great risk

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, a complex glint flickering in his eyes: "Su Qingyao... perhaps she can help me investigate some things." He looked at Ye Qing. "But this matter requires long-term planning." Ye Qing nodded thoughtfully: "That woman is indeed not simple. Approaching you repeatedly—I really don't know if it's a blessing or a curse." Chen Ji did not answer, merely silently calculating his next move in the chess game.

In the depths of the secret realm, cold wind howled. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing toward where Ling Yuan had disappeared. His mind repeatedly replayed every detail from moments ago. Bloodline mark, Chen Xuan, inheritor candidate... All clues pointed to a possibility he had never imagined. He slowly raised his hand, pressing it against the hidden bloodline mark in his dantian. The faint resonance from there told him this was no illusion. Ling Yuan's words were like a thorn, deeply embedded in his heart, taking root and sprouting,隐隐作痛. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying a sigh: "Child, some truths... may be heavier than you can imagine. Are you... ready?"

Ling Yuan's parting whisper lingered in the air, those words like a key, quietly opening a door long sealed shut. "Chen Ji... The fate between us runs deeper than you can imagine." Chen Ji clenched his fists, his knuckles whitening. At this moment, he finally realized that the bloodline mystery between himself and the Tianqing Sect Master was far more complex than he had imagined. Ye Qing stood silently beside him, not disturbing him. She knew that what Chen Ji needed at this moment was not comfort, but space to think. The wind in the secret realm mourned past, as ifwhispered诉说着 some ancient secret. Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing all emotional fluctuations deep into his heart. No matter how艰险 the road ahead, he must continue. To investigate the truth, to protect those he cares about, and to... unravel the mystery of his own identity. Dark clouds slowly gathered on the horizon; a storm was coming. And in the depths of this secret realm, an even greater storm was quietly brewing.
